build_command: if [ -f /etc/purple-stock-app/env ]; then TMP_ENV=/tmp/purple_stock_app_build_env; sudo cp /etc/purple-stock-app/env "$TMP_ENV"; sudo chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$TMP_ENV"; chmod 600 "$TMP_ENV"; set -a; . "$TMP_ENV"; set +a; rm -f "$TMP_ENV"; fi; if [ -n "${DATABASE_URL:-}" ]; then npm run build; else echo 'DATABASE_URL missing; skipping next build until env sync'; fi
